final: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount > 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio IS NULL, avg_pressratio DESC LIMIT 10
